source.title: Changes in the Board of Directors (July 2019)
source.content:
Olivér Perge’s term as a member of the Board of Directors of the WCA has come to an end on July 1st. We want to thank Olivér for the amazing things he has done, the milestones he achieved and the steps he paved for the future of the WCA. We wish him all the best in his future activities!

In the meantime, an anonymous election took place among the WCA Delegates, Team/Committee Leaders and Senior Members in accordance with [Motion 05.2019.1](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/05.2019.1%20-%20Election%20of%20Directors.pdf).

The WCA received the applications of Jacob Ambrose and Ethan Pride.

We are happy to announce that the results of the election promoted **Ethan Pride as a new member of the WCA Board of Directors!**

These changes have become effective immediately.

Jacob’s and Ethan’s applications can be viewed [here](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1CldZIG3D2P8SMirhf-dDNFCckAqwNuc6?usp=sharing).

translation.title: WCA 董事会成员变动（2019 年 7 月）
translation.content:
Olivér Perge 担任 WCA 董事的任期已于 7 月 1 日结束。感谢 Olivér 所做的出色工作、达成的重要目标，以及为 WCA 未来发展打下的基础。祝愿他今后一切顺利！

与此同时，依照[动议 05.2019.1](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/05.2019.1%20-%20Election%20of%20Directors.pdf)，WCA 代表、团队／委员会负责人及高级成员进行了不记名投票。

WCA 收到了 Jacob Ambrose 和 Ethan Pride 的申请。

我们很高兴地宣布，根据选举结果，**Ethan Pride 当选 WCA 新任董事！**

上述变动立即生效。

Jacob 和 Ethan 的申请材料可在[此处](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1CldZIG3D2P8SMirhf-dDNFCckAqwNuc6?usp=sharing)查看。
